verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Deepgram publishes a downloadable OpenAPI document: openapi.json returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. However, the Voice Agent API runs over a single WebSocket, and nothing shows this spec covers the agent's converse endpoint or messages (e.g. via AsyncAPI). That leaves coverage of this product's core interface unproven. missing for 10: evidence that the spec covers the Voice Agent WebSocket protocol (Settings, InjectAgentMessage, function-call messages), first-party documentation describing the spec and its scope, independent corroboration of its completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.deepgram.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
